# Shuuty

> Shuuty is a mobile app for iPhone, iPad and Android for creating tasks by voice and handing them to friends, family, teams and groups, with reminders, chat, calendars, meetings and nearby discovery in one context. Say it. Delegate it. Get it done.

Last updated: 2026-09-24. Publisher: Shuuty Prosta Spółka Akcyjna (Shuuty P.S.A.), Poland. The app is available in English, Polish and Norwegian; the public website is in English and Polish, with the product and support pages also in Norwegian. Shuuty (shuuty.com) is not related to Shuut, Shouty or Shuuto. Older descriptions of Shuuty focus on meetups and interest groups; today the core is voice tasks and delegation, with groups and meetings built around them.

## Official downloads

- [Shuuty on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/shuuty/id6670202422)
- [Shuuty on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.shuuty.app)

## Plans

- Start on the Free plan. Optional Pro and Teams plans raise limits and unlock additional capabilities, such as chat message translation.
- Prices depend on the country and are shown in the App Store and Google Play.
